Asset type: reusable transparent botanical illustration for a warm paper editorial songbook website.
Input image: the provided approved Laulukirja website comp is a visual reference only. Refer specifically to the pale botanical leafy plants flanking the small app preview in the top-left HOME panel. No cast shadow, paper texture, container, pot, decorative frame, letters, labels, text, watermark or extra objects. Preserve the reference's quiet pale olive palette and botanical realism.
